correctness.rationale: Every tournament on seven labelled vertices corresponds to one 21-bit orientation; sound score-bound pruning enumerates precisely 2640 regular states. Exactly 14 cyclic triples in each (35 total minus 7*binom(3,2) transitive triples), so the interchange graph is 14-regular with 18480 edges; 3-bit flips imply bipartiteness. Independent complete all-source BFS found 3 profiles: sizes 240:(1,14,91,343,749,871,476,92,3), 1680:(1,14,91,340,739,853,483,113,6), 720:(1,14,91,336,721,822,485,147,22,1); graph connected, radius 8, diameter 9. Independent exact-cover recursion enumerated all 30 labelled Steiner triple systems, giving 2 cyclic Fano decompositions for 1920 states, 0 for 720. A seven-step converse path must reverse all 21 arcs once, hence is equivalent to a directed Fano decomposition; opposite parity excludes eight where none, and all-source BFS shows 720 exceptional states with unique antipode converse at nine, i.e. 360 unordered diameter pairs. Entire finite state space was enumerated, not a sample.

evidence: The Brualdi–Li diameter prediction (n-1)^2/4 gives nine for n=7, and McShine connectivity are already prior; neither determines all 2640 distances, orbitwise eccentricity, or Fano-equivalent converse paths.
